Title: Array
Description: A collection of items stored at contiguous memory locations.
Explanation:
An array is the simplest and most widely used data structure. It stores elements of the same type in a linear order.

**Characteristics:**
- **Fixed Size**: In many languages, arrays have a fixed size upon creation.
- **Fast Access**: You can access any element in O(1) time if you know the index.
- **Insertion/Deletion**: Slow (O(n)) because elements may need to be shifted.
